title: 2021 AMC 10A Problem 14
statement: All the roots of the polynomial \[ \begin{aligned} &z^6-10z^5+Az^4+Bz^3\\ &\quad+Cz^2+Dz+16 \end{aligned} \] are positive integers, possibly repeated. What is the value of \(B?\)

solutions.text:
By Vieta’s formulas, the six roots have sum \(10\) and product \(16.\) Because the product is a power of \(2,\) every positive integer root is a power of \(2.\) Distributing the four factors of \(2\) among six roots gives the least possible sum when four roots are \(2\) and two roots are \(1\); that sum is already \(10.\) Hence the roots are \[1,1,2,2,2,2.\]

The coefficient \(B\) is the negative of the sum of all products of three roots. Choosing zero, one, or two of the two roots equal to \(1\) gives \[ \begin{aligned} B&=-\left(\binom43 2^3+2\binom42 2^2\right.\\ &\qquad\left.+\binom41 2\right)\\ &=-88. \end{aligned} \]

Thus, A is the correct answer.
hints: Use Vieta to determine the sum and product of the six positive integer roots
Find the only six positive integers with product \(16\) and sum \(10\)
